SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION REPORT - NOT A REAL PATIENT

EXAM: CT of the chest, abdomen and pelvis with IV contrast.

CLINICAL HISTORY: Stage IV non-small cell lung carcinoma. Baseline staging prior to
initiation of first-line systemic therapy.

COMPARISON: None available.

TECHNIQUE: Contrast-enhanced multidetector CT from the thoracic inlet through the
pubic symphysis.

FINDINGS:

CHEST:
There is a spiculated primary mass in the left lower lobe measuring 52 mm
in greatest dimension, consistent with the patient's known non-small cell lung
carcinoma. A metastatic deposit in the right upper lobe measures 28 mm.
No pleural effusion. No pneumothorax. Heart size is normal. No malignant
mediastinal or hilar lymphadenopathy.

ABDOMEN:
A liver metastatic deposit measures 40 mm.
No biliary ductal dilatation. The spleen, pancreas and adrenal glands are unremarkable. No ascites. The kidneys enhance symmetrically without hydronephrosis.

PELVIS:
No pelvic lymphadenopathy. Urinary bladder is unremarkable. No free pelvic fluid.

OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
No aggressive osseous lesion. No fracture.

IMPRESSION:
1. Left lower lobe primary NSCLC measuring 52 mm (target lesion).
2. Liver metastatic deposit measuring 40 mm (target lesion).
3. Right upper lobe lung metastasis measuring 28 mm (target lesion).
4. No osseous metastatic disease. No malignant lymphadenopathy.

EXAM: CT of the chest, abdomen and pelvis with IV contrast.

CLINICAL HISTORY: Stage IV non-small cell lung carcinoma on maintenance systemic therapy.
Surveillance restaging. Rising tumour markers reported clinically.

COMPARISON: CT chest/abdomen/pelvis dated 2025-06-23.

TECHNIQUE: Contrast-enhanced multidetector CT from the thoracic inlet through the
pubic symphysis.

FINDINGS:

CHEST:
The left lower lobe primary mass measures 34 mm, increased from 31 mm.
The right upper lobe lung metastasis measures 18 mm, increased from 16 mm.
There is a new 7 mm subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe. It is
indeterminate and too small to characterize on this examination.
No pleural effusion. No pneumothorax. Heart size is normal. No malignant
mediastinal or hilar lymphadenopathy.

ABDOMEN:
The liver metastatic deposit measures 26 mm, increased from 23 mm.
No biliary ductal dilatation. The spleen, pancreas and adrenal glands are unremarkable. No ascites. The kidneys enhance symmetrically without hydronephrosis.

PELVIS:
No pelvic lymphadenopathy. Urinary bladder is unremarkable. No free pelvic fluid.

OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
No aggressive osseous lesion. No fracture.

IMPRESSION:
1. Left lower lobe primary NSCLC measures 34 mm, further increased.
2. Liver metastatic deposit measures 26 mm, further increased.
3. Right upper lobe lung metastasis measures 18 mm, further increased.
4. Interval increase in all three target lesions relative to the nadir
   examination of 2024-11-11. Sizes nonetheless remain below the pre-treatment
   baseline of 2024-02-05.
5. New 7 mm subpleural nodule in the right lower lobe, indeterminate and too
   small to characterize. Attention on follow-up imaging is recommended.
